canada.title: Warnings out for widespread wind, potential precipitation in Sask.

canada.title: Silver Alert issued for missing man, 85, last seen in Winnipeg's St. Vital area
canada.summary: Winnipeg police have issued a Silver Alert for a missing 85-year-old man who was last seen on Wednesday night.

canada.title: Molly Carlson’s iceberg dive earns applause but also a safety advocate’s warning
canada.summary: Canadian cliff diver Molly Carlson recently made history off the coast of Newfoundland, becoming the first woman to dive off an iceberg. Lifesaving Society Ontario spokesperson Stephanie Bakalar wants people to remember Carlson is a professional with a team and don’t try this at home.

canada.summary: The move is meant to "strengthen digital security and give people more choice and convenience," while also being more cost-effective.

canada.title: Inquest into death of Regis Korchinski-Paquet set to continue after early pause
canada.summary: The inquest has heard Korchinski-Paquet experienced seizures from epilepsy and had two on May 27, 2020, the day she died.

canada.title: Developer pitching subdivision outside Shubenacadie gets earful
canada.summary: An open house about a proposed subdivision that could bring dozens of homes near the Shubenacadie Wildlife Park started with the proponent informing area residents that construction could theoretically start at any time.

canada.title: Ballots cast on election day in B.C. to be counted by hand
canada.summary: Elections B.C. says votes cast on election day on Saturday will be tallied manually, due to "short time frames and complex operational logistics of a snap election."
